repetir.def: To say the same words again, one time after another.

deuda.def: The money you still have to find or to give back.

empezar.def: To do a thing for the first time and go on from there.

feria.def: The yearly town fair, with rides, food stalls and betting.

puesto.def: The small stall where one person sells things at the fair.

palenque.def: The round ring where the cockfights are held at the fair.

gallo.def: A male chicken, and the animal that fights in the palenque.

corredor.def: The man who takes the bets and shouts the odds out loud.

colorado.def: Red, said of an animal in the Mexican countryside.

llegar.def: To arrive somewhere, reaching the place you were heading for.

olvidar.def: To forget, losing from memory what you once knew.

caleño.def: From Cali; the way its people speak and are.

qué más.def: What else is new; the everyday Colombian hello.

mija.def: My dear; warm Colombian short form of mi hija.

oxidarse.def: To rust, get stiff from not being used.

escaparse.def: To slip away from you just when you need it.

parquear.def: To park; loan word many returnees bring back home.

rentar.def: To rent; loan word that Colombia hears as foreign.

arrendar.def: To rent, lease; the word Colombia actually uses.

desempolvar.def: To dust off something stored away too long.

dar pena.def: To embarrass; in Colombia, pena means shame, not sorrow.

chueco.def: Crooked, lopsided; a smile pulled to one side.

socio.def: Business partner; the person who runs it with you.

gringo.def: Foreigner from the north; here, a teasing nickname.

pegado.def: Stuck to something, pressed close against it all day.

a medio camino.def: Halfway there, stopped before reaching the end of something.

como si nada.def: As if nothing had happened at all in between.

de toda la vida.def: Lifelong; known and trusted since you can remember.

en ninguna parte.def: Nowhere; in no place at all, lost completely.

paradero.def: a bus stop, the everyday Peruvian word for one

combi.def: a small crowded minibus that runs across Lima

asu.def: a Lima exclamation of surprise, like wow or whoa

habla causa.def: hey buddy, a classic Lima greeting between friends

piña.def: bad luck, or being unlucky; todo piña means all going wrong

cachear.def: to understand or catch on to what is being said

al toque.def: right away, immediately, in a flash without waiting

floro.def: smooth talk or nonsense meant to charm or mislead

paltearse.def: to get flustered, embarrassed or worried over something

por la firme.def: honestly and for real, no kidding around at all

roche.def: embarrassment or shame from an awkward humiliating moment

lorna.def: a clueless fool, someone slow on the uptake

pata.def: a friend or buddy, a Lima staple word

monse.def: dull, lame or clueless, not really with it

prenderse el foco.def: to have a sudden bright idea, the lightbulb moment

cachado.def: figured out or understood, caught on to it

chibola.def: a young girl or kid, a Lima word

germa.def: a girl or young woman, from mujer flipped around

mostro.def: awesome, amazing and really impressive, simply top quality

yunta.def: a tight crew of close friends, ride or die
